activities.description: Acquires the pipeline execution lock so two silver runs cannot overlap. Retry is deliberately 0: replaying a lock acquisition is not idempotent.
activities.name: SP_LockPipeline

activities.description: Starts the Databricks job that runs NB_Bronze_To_Silver, authenticated with the factory managed identity. Retry MUST stay 0: jobs/run-now is not idempotent, and a replay starts a second run that max_concurrent_runs then skips.
activities.name: WB_Trigger_Run

activities.description: Captures the Databricks job run id used by the polling loop.
activities.name: ST_SetRunId

activities.description: Reads the current run state and the per-task run id. GET is idempotent, so retries are safe here.
activities.name: WB_Get_Run

activities.description: Polls the Databricks run until it reaches a terminal lifecycle state.
activities.name: UNTIL_RunComplete

activities.description: Terminal result state of the Databricks run: SUCCESS, FAILED, TIMEDOUT, SKIPPED or MAXIMUM_CONCURRENT_RUNS_REACHED.
activities.name: ST_SetResultState

activities.description: Only a SUCCESS run has a task with an output. Guarding here keeps the notebook_output expression from ever being evaluated for a skipped or crashed run.

ifFalseActivities.description: Explains a run that never produced a result, e.g. skipped by max_concurrent_runs.
ifFalseActivities.name: ST_SetRunFailureMsg

value.value: @concat('Databricks run did not succeed (life_cycle_state=', variables('lifeCycle'), ', result_state=', variables('resultState'), '); the notebook never reached dbutils.notebook.exit.')

ifTrueActivities.description: Fetches the notebook exit payload. Runs API requires the task-level run id, not the job run id.
ifTrueActivities.name: WB_Get_Output

ifTrueActivities.description: Keeps the raw JSON; defaults to {} when the notebook died before exiting.
ifTrueActivities.name: ST_SetRawOutput

ifTrueActivities.description: SUCCESS / PARTIAL / FAILED as reported by the orchestrator.
ifTrueActivities.name: ST_SetResultStatus

ifTrueActivities.description: Total rows written across all entities.
ifTrueActivities.name: ST_SetRowsWritten

ifTrueActivities.description: First failing entity's error, surfaced to the audit table.
ifTrueActivities.name: ST_SetErrorMsg

activities.name: IF_RunSucceeded

activities.description: Branches on the orchestrator status field, not on the task result.

ifFalseActivities.description: Fails the pipeline with the orchestrator's own error text.

message.value: @concat('Silver layer did not fully succeed (status=', variables('resultStatus'), '). ', variables('errorMsg'))

ifFalseActivities.name: FA_ReportFailure

activities.name: IF_SilverSucceeded

activities.description: Releases the lock and writes real metrics. Runs on both outcomes so a failure cannot strand the lock.
activities.name: SP_UnlockPipeline

description: Bronze -> Silver orchestration. Triggers the Databricks serverless job, polls it, parses the orchestrator's JSON status, and records real metrics on the pipeline lock row. Fails the pipeline unless every silver entity succeeded.
name: PL_BronzeToSilver

errorMsg.defaultValue: Silver pipeline produced no result payload; inspect the Data Factory activity error.
